entities.summary: Botanical gardens in Ukraine have collections consisting entirely of Ukraine native and endemic species; most have a collection that include plants from around the world. There are botanical gardens and arboreta in all the states and territories of Ukraine. Most are administered by local governments although some are privately owned.
